string.text: Lone Wolf\\n Stalker. You've probably heard of the stalker bar by now, right? A place in the heart of the Zone, where stalkers gather after returning from distant raids. I can tell you they're interested in you, but they're not waiting for you empty-handed. There's a house in the Dark Valley area, and the bartender there is very interested in the documents that may be there....

Lone Wolf\\n ...This loot will be your pass to the elite club, and you will automatically move into the category of experienced. However, you can't get into the valley for no reason - there is some kind of installation on its territory, which generates maddening psi noise....

Lone Wolf\\n You need a special blocker. The troopers had a raid there recently, and it looks like they're all dead. I have information that a couple of soldiers made it out to the dump. I'm sure one of them has an interlock. They were seen at a crossing where a small creek runs off of it.
Lone Wolf\\n Stalker, watch out, there's a pseudo-dog!
Lone Wolf\\n Wait, don't go! Messer!

Lone Wolf\\n Well, here we are. The pillow is all yours. Make yourself comfortable. I think you should get about seven or eight hours of sleep. The doors are only locked from the inside, and once the door is open, the compartment is considered unoccupied. You can't lock it from the outside, so everyone carries their own stuff. And if anything, you have to be ready to evacuate at a moment's notice. You get some sleep, and then we'll go to the bar, where we can drink, eat, and talk.
Lone Wolf\\n You awake? Alright, time to move to the bar...
Lone Wolf\\n Hey, Messer! Wait.
Incoming message:\\n Sprout: Man, come with us! We got that gangster bastard that put seven of our guys in that house up on the hill, help us smack that bastard! Come here, I'll tell you what's what.
\\n Where's my gun, Messer?! What, you're keeping it for yourself? Well, I'll remember that for you, Messer!

Toad\\n Messer, come in. So here's the situation: I need to get something. It's called the Toad's Eye. It's located in the Junkyard to the north. I sent a group there before last, but they lost contact almost as soon as they got there. One of my defectors said that in the place where they saw the artifact there was no abnormal activity, but they were afraid to go there. So go to the junkyard and get me that artifact. The coordinates of the location are attached.

Toad\\n Yeah, one more thing. That thing you shot stole one of my courier's documents while he was sleeping in the factory. He said it had some kind of lair on the roof. Maybe the creature took them there. Find them and bring them to me, as they have some value. Don't come back without them.
Toad\\n I don't get it, is he dead or something? What the hell were you looking at? I sent you to him. Let's go back to my bunker.

Toad\\n Oh, I forgot. In your PDA you have the ability to display the contacts of stalkers that are within a radius of about 200 meters from you. With some of them you can talk at a distance. To do this, select the desired stalker in the contacts section. There you can also find out a brief biography of this stalker. Try to reach Digger via PDA when you are near him. I think you'll get out of it....
Toad\\n Yeah, one more thing... Your PDA has a charge, and it discharges over time. Keep an eye on the charge level so that at the right moment you won't be left without a PDA...
Toad\\n How are you, alive?

Toad\\n Messer, there's something going on at the checkpoint after the emission. I can't get any signals from there, it's like there's no one there. Listen, why don't you run over there quietly and see what's going on? But if you do, get the hell out of there. Tell me what you see.
Watchdog\\n Hey, man, come here, we'll talk. Just help us deal with the pack first...
Watchdog\\n How you feeling, rookie?
Crow's Eye\\n He's doing great! And he's no rookie either, if you'd seen the way he deftly took down the ringleader...
Watchdog\\n Yes... he's no newbie. Come, we need to talk.
Duty\\n Watch out! There's a pseudo-dog! Somebody kill it! Hurry up! Stalker, get it off!
Duty Leader\\n Fighters, take your positions! The dead are coming. Messer, this is your chance to make your mark.
Duty Leader\\n Chin up, men! Another wave is coming!
Duty Leader\\n Attention all! We are detecting strange interference in the air, everyone watch both...
Duty Leader\\n Okay, we've got the rat, all right... he's pushing our ammo to the left. Go to our merchant for the reward.
Incoming message.\\n Ah... critters...
Incoming message.\\n Damn it. I knew there was something wrong here. Okay, let's go to another place...

Incoming message.\\n Sergey, the group is dead... And the main thing is that everyone is dead here... in safety... bloodsuckers! Damn it... what to do now... Thanks for coming with me, stalker. I owe you one. If you need me, look for me where I was or at the bar. I need a drink.
Incoming message.\\n Fucking door.

I've got a special order here. Bring anything weird you find. You never know what kind of surprise the Zone will spring on you next time. It's ten times the price for an unknown artifact. And hurry, you're not alone

Hey, are you outside the Cordon now? I was told a strange artifact was seen in that area. Bring anything strange you find. You never know what kind of surprise the Zone will give you next time. There's a tenfold fee for an unknown artifact. And hurry, you're not alone
There's information about a special artifact in the area where you are. Bring anything weird you find. You never know what surprise the Zone will give you next time.
Message:\\n Hmm, looks like the source of the contamination...
Message:\\n Hmm, looks like the source of the contagion...
Message:\\n Messer, this is the leader of the Duty faction. I'm waiting for you at my place, we need to talk.
Incoming message: Max.\\n It's working! Let's run to the hall and see what's going on!
Incoming message: Max.\\n The light is on, my friend, the light is on!
Incoming message: Max.\\n This is it! This is what I was talking about!
Incoming message: Max.\\n Yes, I'm coming to you.
Message:\\n Shit, there's someone out there, everybody be on the lookout!
Message: Group\\n Everyone group up! Remember, our goal now is to get to the tunnel leading to Rostock.
Message: Leader\\n Okay, it's quiet. Come stalker, we'll discuss what to do next...
Message: Leader\\n Keep quiet... Everyone check your guns...
Message:\\n Leader There's something there...
Message: Black Slug\\n Halt! Let's take the bastards down! Whoa... who are these guys?
Black Slug\\n Okay, put the guns away, guys. This is just an ID check. You try to run, you're gonna get shot, I'm telling you.
Black Slug\\n What the hell?! Nail, go check it out. We're holding these ones, don't piss--
Message: Black Slug\\n There's nothing here! Let's go get these guys and get the fuck outta here!
Message: Black Slug\\n You! Get your backpack off!
Message: Black Slug\\n Fuck! Get the fuck away!
Message:\\n Leader Messer! Get out of here, let's go!
Message:\\n Leader Messer! Follow me, let's get out of here, hurry up! What the hell is this place!? That thing dragged you down here before I could get here!
Message: Leader\\n It's quiet. Shit. Go to the bar and talk to the bartender about what happened. I'm not going with you, I have some things I need to take care of... Go!
Chrom:\\n I think I got a signal. Wait a bit, our guys will give them a warm welcome. If you can, do us a favor and help our guys. I don't think they'll know who attacked them in the dark.
Incoming Freedom:\\n Quiet, boys. Let's try to get in quietly...
Message: Monolith\\n Stalker, get out of here... this is none of your business.
Message:\\n Hey, stalker! Bro, come here, I have something to do!
Message:\\n This password expired on 20.02.2012. Please enter a new password.
Messer:\\n Fuck... Fucking Slug...
Message:\\n I don't get it? Uh, bro, you come over here, around the corner.
Message: Jackal\\n Messer, turn on your PDA and find me through the Contacts tab. I'll tell you what's what...
Message\\n Connection lost.
